segments.sn22.3:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā mahākaccāno avantīsu viharati kuraraghare [kulaghare (ka.)] papāte pabbate.
segments.sn22.3:1.3: Atha kho hāliddikāni [hāliddakāni (sī.), haliddikāni (syā.)] gahapati yenāyasmā mahākaccāno tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho hāliddikāni gahapati āyasmantaṃ mahākaccānaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn22.3:2.3: Kāmehi ritto apurakkharāno [apurekkharāno (sī. suttanipātepi) moggallāne 5-135 suttampi oloketabbaṃ],
segments.sn22.3:3.1: “Imassa nu kho, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa kathaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti?
segments.sn22.3:4.2: Rūpadhāturāgavinibandhañca [… vinibaddhañja (pī. sī. aṭṭha.)] pana viññāṇaṃ ‘okasārī’ti vuccati.
segments.sn22.3:5.2: Rūpadhātuyā kho, gahapati, yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī [nandi (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] yā taṇhā ye upayupādānā [upāyupādānā (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā [anabhāvakatā (sī. pī.), anabhāvaṃgatā (syā. kaṃ.)] āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.sn22.3:5.4: Vedanādhātuyā kho, gahapati … saññādhātuyā kho, gahapati … saṅkhāradhātuyā kho, gahapati … viññāṇadhātuyā kho, gahapati, yo chando yo rāgo yā nandī yā taṇhā ye upayupādānā cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayā te tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.sn22.3:6.3: Saddanimitta … pe … gandhanimitta … rasanimitta … phoṭṭhabbanimitta … dhammanimittaniketavisāravinibandhā kho, gahapati,‘niketasārī’ti vuccati.
segments.sn22.3:7.2: Rūpanimittaniketavisāravinibandhā kho, gahapati, tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.sn22.3:7.4: Saddanimitta … gandhanimitta … rasanimitta … phoṭṭhabbanimitta … dhammanimittaniketavisāravinibandhā kho, gahapati, tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.sn22.3:8.2: Idha, gahapati, ekacco gihīhi [gihi (ka.)] saṃsaṭṭho viharati sahanandī sahasokī, sukhitesu sukhito, dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu attanā tesu yogaṃ āpajjati.
segments.sn22.3:8.3: Evaṃ kho, gahapati, gāme santhavajāto hoti.
segments.sn22.3:9.2: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu gihīhi [gihi (ka.)] asaṃsaṭṭho viharati na sahanandī na sahasokī na sukhitesu sukhito na dukkhitesu dukkhito, uppannesu kiccakaraṇīyesu na attanā tesu yogaṃ āpajjati.
segments.sn22.3:9.3: Evaṃ kho, gahapati, gāme na santhavajāto hoti.
segments.sn22.3:10.2: Idha, gahapati, ekacco kāmesu avigatarāgo hoti avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho.
segments.sn22.3:10.3: Evaṃ kho, gahapati, kāmehi aritto hoti.
segments.sn22.3:11.2: Idha, gahapati, ekacco kāmesu vigatarāgo hoti vigatachando vigatapemo vigatapipāso vigatapariḷāho vigatataṇho.
segments.sn22.3:11.3: Evaṃ kho, gahapati, kāmehi ritto hoti.
segments.sn22.3:12.3: ‘evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃvedano siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃsañño siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānan’ti.
segments.sn22.3:13.2: Idha, gahapati, ekaccassa na evaṃ hoti –
segments.sn22.3:13.3: ‘evaṃrūpo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃvedano siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃsañño siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃsaṅkhāro siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānaṃ, evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatamaddhānan’ti.
segments.sn22.3:14.1: “Kathañca, gahapati, kathaṃ viggayha janena kattā hoti?
segments.sn22.3:14.2: Idha, gahapati, ekacco evarūpiṃ kathaṃ kattā hoti –
segments.sn22.3:14.3: ‘na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi; ahaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāmi. Kiṃ tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānissasi? Micchāpaṭipanno tvamasi; ahamasmi sammāpaṭipanno. Pure vacanīyaṃ pacchā avaca; pacchā vacanīyaṃ pure avaca. Sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ te. Adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattaṃ. Āropito te vādo; cara vādappamokkhāya. Niggahitosi; nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī’ti.
segments.sn22.3:14.4: Evaṃ kho, gahapati, kathaṃ viggayha janena kattā hoti.
segments.sn22.3:15.1: “Kathañca, gahapati, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kattā hoti?
segments.sn22.3:15.2: Idha, gahapati, bhikkhu na evarūpiṃ kathaṃ kattā hoti –
segments.sn22.3:15.3: ‘na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi … pe … nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosī’ti.
segments.sn22.3:15.4: Evaṃ kho, gahapati, kathaṃ na viggayha janena kattā hoti.
segments.sn22.3:16.1: “Iti kho, gahapati, yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ bhagavatā aṭṭhakavaggiye māgaṇḍiyapañhe –
segments.sn22.3:18.1: “Imassa kho, gahapati, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabbo”ti.

lines: Tassa kira pabbatassa ekaṃ passaṃ chinditvā pātitaṃ viya ahosi.
Iti thero tasmiṃ raṭṭhe taṃ nagaraṃ nissāya tasmiṃ pabbate viharati.
Aṭṭhakavaggiye māgaṇḍiyapañheti aṭṭhakavaggikamhi māgaṇḍiyapañho nāma atthi, tasmiṃ pañhe.
Kasmā panettha “viññāṇadhātu kho, gahapatī”ti na vuttanti?

“Oko”ti hi atthato paccayo vuccati, purejātañca kammaviññāṇaṃ pacchājātassa kammaviññāṇassapi vipākaviññāṇassapi vipākaviññāṇañca vipākaviññāṇassapi kammaviññāṇassapi paccayo hoti, tasmā “kataraṃ nu kho idha viññāṇan”ti?
Sammoho bhaveyya, tassa vighātatthaṃ taṃ agahetvā asambhinnāva desanā katā.
Apica ārammaṇavasena catasso abhisaṅkhāraviññāṇaṭṭhitiyo vuttāti tā dassetumpi idha viññāṇaṃ na gahitaṃ.
Upayupādānāti taṇhūpayadiṭṭhūpayavasena dve upayā, kāmupādānādīni cattāri upādānāni ca.
Cetaso adhiṭṭhānābhinivesānusayāti akusalacittassa adhiṭṭhānabhūtā ceva abhinivesabhūtā ca anusayabhūtā ca.
Sabbesampi hi khīṇāsavānaṃ ete pahīnāva, satthu pana khīṇāsavabhāvo loke atipākaṭoti uparimakoṭiyā evaṃ vuttaṃ.
Kilesā hi na kevalaṃ catūsuyeva khandhesu pahīnā pahīyanti, pañcasupi pahīyantiyevāti kilesappahānadassanatthaṃ gahitaṃ.
Evaṃ kho, gahapati, anokasārī hotīti evaṃ kammaviññāṇena okaṃ asarantena anokasārī nāma hoti.
Rūpanimittaniketavisāravinibandhāti rūpameva kilesānaṃ paccayaṭṭhena nimittaṃ, ārammaṇakiriyasaṅkhātanivāsanaṭṭhānaṭṭhena niketanti rūpanimittaniketaṃ.

Ubhayenapi hi kilesānaṃ patthaṭabhāvo ca vinibandhanabhāvo ca vutto, rūpanimittanikete visāravinibandhāti rūpanimittaniketavisāravinibandhā, tasmā rūpanimittaniketamhi uppannena kilesavisārena ceva kilesabandhanena cāti attho.
Kasmā panettha pañcakkhandhā “okā”ti vuttā, cha ārammaṇāni “niketan”ti?
Samānepi hi etesaṃ ālayaṭṭhena visayabhāve okoti niccanivāsanaṭṭhānagehameva vuccati, niketanti “ajja asukaṭṭhāne kīḷissāmā”ti katasaṅketaṭṭhānaṃ nivāsaṭṭhānaṃ uyyānādi.
Tattha yathā puttadāradhanadhaññapuṇṇagehe chandarāgo balavā hoti, evaṃ ajjhattikesu khandhesu.
Yathā pana uyyānaṭṭhānādīsu tato dubbalataro hoti, evaṃ bāhiresu chasu ārammaṇesūti chandarāgassa balavadubbalatāya evaṃ desanā katāti veditabbo.
Sukhitesu sukhitoti upaṭṭhākesu dhanadhaññalābhādivasena sukhitesu “idānāhaṃ manāpaṃ bhojanaṃ labhissāmī”ti gehasitasukhena sukhito hoti, tehi pattasampattiṃ anubhavamāno viya carati.
Dukkhitesu dukkhitoti tesaṃ kenacideva kāraṇena dukkhe uppanne sayaṃ dviguṇena dukkhena dukkhito hoti.
Tesu yogaṃ āpajjatīti upayogaṃ sayaṃ tesaṃ kiccānaṃ kattabbataṃ āpajjati.
Evaṃ kho, gahapati, kāmehi aritto hotīti evaṃ kilesakāmehi aritto hoti anto kāmānaṃ bhāvena atuccho.
Evaṃrūpo siyantiādīsu dīgharassakāḷodātādīsu rūpesu “evaṃrūpo nāma bhaveyyan”ti pattheti.
cakkhuviññāṇādīsu viññāṇesu “evaṃ viññāṇo nāma bhaveyyan”ti pattheti.
Sahitaṃ me, asahitaṃ teti tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ asahitaṃ asiliṭṭhaṃ, mayhaṃ sahitaṃ siliṭṭhaṃ madhurapānasadisaṃ.
Adhiciṇṇaṃ te viparāvattanti yaṃ tuyhaṃ dīghena kālena paricitaṃ suppaguṇaṃ, taṃ mama vādaṃ āgamma sabbaṃ khaṇena viparāvattaṃ nivattaṃ.
Āropito te vādoti tuyhaṃ doso mayā āropito.
Cara vādappamokkhāyāti taṃ taṃ ācariyaṃ upasaṅkamitvā uttari pariyesanto imassa vādassa mokkhāya cara āhiṇḍāhi.
Nibbeṭhehi vā sace pahosīti atha sayameva pahosi, idheva nibbeṭhehīti.

lines: Rūpadhātumhi ārammaṇapaccayabhūtena rāgena sahajātenapi asahajātenapi upanissayabhūtena appahīnabhāveneva vinibaddhaṃ paṭibaddhaṃ kammaviññāṇaṃ.
Ugacchati vā ettha vedanādīhi saddhiṃ samavetīti oko, cakkhurūpādi.
“Viññāṇadhātu kho, gahapatī”ti evaṃ vutte “kammaviññāṇavipākaviññāṇesu kataraṃ nu kho”ti sammoho bhaveyya.
“rūpupayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, rūpārammaṇan”tiādinā (saṃ. ni.3.53).
Abhinivesabhūtāti taṃ taṃ ārammaṇaṃ abhinivissa ajjhosāya pavattiyā kāraṇabhūtā.
Pubbe aggahitaṃ viññāṇaṃ aggahitamevāti katvā kasmā idha desanā katāti codeti –

Pubbe “viññāṇadhāturāgavinibandhañca viññāṇan”ti vuccamāne yathā yathā sammoho siyā paccayapaccayuppannavibhāgassa dukkarattā, idha pana sammohassa okāsova natthi avisesena pañcasu khandhesu kilesappahānavasenāti.
Ārammaṇa … pe … niketanti ārammaṇakaraṇasaṅkhātena nivāsaṭṭhānabhūtena rūpameva niketanti rūpanimittaniketaṃ.
Chandarāgassa balavadubbalatāyāti ajjhattakhandhapañcake chandarāgassa balavabhāvena taṃ “oko”ti, bahiddhā chasu ārammaṇesu tassa dubbalatāya tāni “niketan”ti vuttāni.
Idāni yathāvuttamatthaṃ pākaṭaṃ katvā dassetuṃ “samānepi hī”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Vaṇṇasaddo viya rūpasaddo rūpāyatanassa viya saṇṭhānassapi vācakoti adhippāyena “dīgharassa kāḷodātādīsu rūpesū”ti vuttaṃ.
Tattha hi “abhiṇhaṃ somanassito bhaveyyan”ti patthanā siyā.
